strategy_source_summary: Adapted from supplied affiliate marketing materials: own the site, build topical authority, publish consistently, favor buyer-intent pages, reduce friction, and keep a return channel.
no_cost_adaptation: Static seasonal pages, Atom feed, internal links, and deterministic optimization reports replace paid hosting, paid plugins, paid keyword tools, and paid email systems.

traffic_channels.implementation: Seasonal and product-fit pages create clearer long-tail entry points around buyer intent.
Atom feed lets visitors follow new pages without accounts, email storage, or a paid newsletter service.
Publisher standards page explains disclosure, evidence, and no paid placement rules for future direct affiliate approvals.
Scheduled reports score tools, product-fit pages, seasonal pages, and optional private exports without calling paid APIs.

source_action_items: Prioritize transactional page formats: tool pages, product-fit pages, comparison-style decision pages, and seasonal checklists.
Build internal links from supporting pages to the most relevant calculator and product-fit page.
Use trust cues before monetized links: disclosure, no account, private inputs, and evidence-first limitations.
Do not add paid email, paid keyword, paid AI, ads, or analytics dependencies.
